# =============================================================================
# IDEA-20261003-43f871 -- Rank-diverse ℓ=4 catalog successor for Trace→N_nl
# Spearman after EV-BINSTD-56dda7 (O-INCONCLUSIVE: (17,4) constant ranks on
# EXP-BINSTD-8196d7). Targets ≥3 distinct r_Tr and ≥2 distinct N_nl before
# any Spearman ≤−0.70 band reading. Not a re-run of frozen v1.
# =============================================================================
idea:
  id: IDEA-20261003-43f871
  question_id: RQ-BINSTD-b6f698
  added: '2026-10-03'
  status: proposed
  approved_by: null
  title: >-
    RANK-DIVERSE ℓ=4 SUCCESSOR: MEET distinct_rTr FLOORS BEFORE READING
    SPEARMAN(r_Tr, N_nl). After EV-BINSTD-56dda7, build a diversity-seeking
    ≥24-shape V catalog (new seed/recipe; coordinate subsets + expanders)
    so Stage-1 (17,4) can admit ≥3 distinct r_Tr and ≥2 distinct N_nl before
    the ≤−0.70 band.

  class: heuristic_validation

  claim: >-
    Parent IDEA-20261001-878222 / EXP-BINSTD-8196d7 Stages 0-1 produced
    EV-BINSTD-56dda7: valid package, Stage 0 OK, n17_l3 ρ≈−0.878 in-band,
    but n17_l4 collapsed to constant r_Tr=0 / N_nl=17 (distinct_rTr=1) →
    O-INCONCLUSIVE; decision DEC-20261003-efdb94 inconclusive. CLAIM: a
    rank-diversity-seeking catalog (new seed 202610038196, ≥24 and ≤128
    shapes; shifted poly, geo, affine twists, coordinate ℓ-subsets, random
    expanders; NOT the frozen v1 catalog seed 202610038782) can meet ≥3
    distinct r_Tr and ≥2 distinct N_nl on Stage-1 cells (17,3)/(17,4), after
    which the same HEUR-BINSTD-878222-H1 Spearman ρ(r_Tr, N_nl) ≤ −0.70 band
    is readable as O-SUPPORT or O-FAIL-BAND. CLAIM TIER: heuristic_validation
    / encoding-structure instrument. NO break. NO exponent. NO n≥131
    transfer. Do NOT re-run frozen EXP-BINSTD-8196d7. Prefer this
    rank-diverse ℓ=4 repair over an immediate ℓ-scoped HEUR retreat;
    ℓ-scoped HEUR remains the fallback if floors still fail after max
    catalog.

  mechanism: >-
    OBJECT FRAME. Same representation as IDEA-20261001-878222: FB
    {P : x(P)∈V}, descend S_3, extract Trace-linear block, count residual
    nonlinear clauses N_nl. Operation set CHANGE: replace the collapsing
    ≥12-shape v1 catalog with a rank-diversity-seeking freeze that
    pre-screens r_Tr/N_nl diversity during Stage 0 construction, with
    explicit emphasis on (17,4) where EV-BINSTD-56dda7 saw empty Trace
    blocks. Admission gate: floors before band. Trichotomy: Class I
    instrument. OFF-LIMITS: re-running v1 catalog; dim(V·V)→N_var (febbe1);
    peak RSS (20561e); n≥131. WHAT IS NEW: rank-diverse catalog protocol
    with floors as Stage-1 admission gates citing EV-BINSTD-56dda7.

  novelty_status: unverified
  prior_art:
    frontier_map: knowledge/frontiers/ecdlp
    frontier_map_commit: '7c2b1bb2156137049ed6b7fceb82924163f73b46'
    rows_checked:
      - KR-IC-f5c584
      - KR-IC-5765d2
      - KR-IC-73db3f
      - KR-IC-5a43e5
      - KR-IC-1fcdbc
      - KR-IC-9e610d
    nearest:
      - ref: KR-IC-f5c584
        provenance: recalled
        relation: adjacent
        delta: >-
          Trace linear after S_3 descent; this idea only expands the V
          catalog construction and elevates distinct_rTr floors to Stage-1
          admission gates after EV-BINSTD-56dda7 (internal) floor failure.
      - ref: IDEA-20261003-f20e41
        provenance: internal
        relation: adjacent
        delta: >-
          Parallel catalog-expansion pattern for dim(V·V)→N_var after
          EV-BINSTD-a99d47; this idea targets Trace→N_nl ranks after
          EV-BINSTD-56dda7 under a different pin/observable.
    searched:
      corpus_grep:
        - EV-BINSTD-56dda7 rank diverse ell=4
        - EXP-BINSTD-8196d7 O-INCONCLUSIVE constant r_Tr
        - Trace linear rank residual nonlinear catalog expansion
      web: []
      blocked: []

  origin:
    kind: evidence_followup
    date: '2026-10-03'
    scope: >-
      DEC-20261003-efdb94 NA-2: design successor refining V-catalog so
      (17,4) can achieve distinct_rTr≥3 (prefer rank-diverse catalog over
      immediate ℓ-scoped HEUR retreat).
    cites:
      - EV-BINSTD-56dda7
      - DEC-20261003-efdb94
      - EXP-BINSTD-8196d7
      - IDEA-20261001-878222
      - H-BINSTD-b102b7

  citations:
    - ref: EV-BINSTD-56dda7

        Stages 0-1 valid; n17_l3 in-band; n17_l4 constant ranks
        (distinct_rTr=1); decision inconclusive.
      verified_by: ledger/evidence/EV-BINSTD-56dda7.yaml this session.
    - ref: DEC-20261003-efdb94
      provenance: internal
      claim: Official inconclusive; NA-2 catalog/pin refine or ℓ-scoped HEUR.
      verified_by: ledger/decisions/DEC-20261003-efdb94.yaml this session.
    - ref: IDEA-20261001-878222
      provenance: internal
      claim: Parent HEUR-BINSTD-878222-H1 Spearman≤−0.70 claim.
      verified_by: ledger/proposals/IDEA-20261001-878222.yaml this session.
    - ref: KR-IC-f5c584
      provenance: recalled
      claim: Trace morphism yields a linear after S_3 Weil descent.

  assumptions:
    - New catalog seed/recipe (not v1 seed 202610038782 / ≥12-shape freeze).
    - Same XOR-SAT encoder pin and Spearman band −0.70 as parent.
    - Floors are admission gates before band reading.
    - Encoding-structure correlation ≠ practical binary IC.

  heuristic_assumptions:
    - id: HEUR-BINSTD-878222-H1
      formal_statement: >-
        FORALL Stage-1 cells (17,3)/(17,4): AFTER ≥3 distinct r_Tr and
        ≥2 distinct N_nl on the frozen rank-diversity-seeking catalog,
        Spearman ρ(r_Tr, N_nl) ≤ −0.70.
      random_model_justification: >-
        Same as IDEA-20261001-878222. Catalog expansion is an instrument
        power repair after EV-BINSTD-56dda7, not a new heuristic.
      supporting_results:
        - EV-BINSTD-56dda7
        - IDEA-20261001-878222
        - KR-IC-f5c584
      validation_experiment_ids: []
      falsification_condition: >-
        Floors met and ρ > −0.70 (O-FAIL-BAND); twin failure (O-ARTIFACT);
        floors still unmet after rank-diversity-seeking freeze
        (O-INCONCLUSIVE; then consider ℓ-scoped HEUR).

  predictions:
    - metric: distinct_rTr_values
      direction: lower_bounded
      minimum_effect: '≥ 3 on each Stage-1 cell (admission)'
    - metric: distinct_Nnl_values
      direction: lower_bounded
      minimum_effect: '≥ 2 on each Stage-1 cell (admission)'
    - metric: spearman_rTr_vs_Nnl
      direction: upper_bounded
      minimum_effect: '≤ −0.70 after admission floors'
    - metric: catalog_size
      direction: lower_bounded
      minimum_effect: '≥ 24 distinct V shapes per Stage-1 cell'

  minimal_test: >-
    Stage 0: rank-diversity-seeking freeze (≥24, ≤128), new seeds, band −0.70,
    twin Trace probe; Stage-1 cells pre-screen floors. Stage 1: twin meters;
    admission floors before Spearman band; RESULTS.md one O-* label.
    Budget: ≤4 CPU-hours. No Stage 2. No v1 re-run.

  controls:
    - ctl_fixed_dim_V
    - ctl_frozen_V_catalog
    - ctl_admission_floors_before_band
    - ctl_twin_rTr_Nnl
    - ctl_no_posthoc_band_edit
    - ctl_not_v1_catalog_rerun
    - null_shuffled_linear_block_rank

  falsification_conditions:
    - Re-running EXP-BINSTD-8196d7 frozen v1 catalog under this idea.
    - Reading O-SUPPORT/O-FAIL-BAND without admission floors.
    - Editing the −0.70 band after encodings.
    - Claiming n≥131 transfer or an ECDLP break/exponent.
    - Equating N_nl prediction with total N_var (febbe1) or peak RSS (20561e).

  target_complexity:
    time_exponent: >-
      No exponent claimed. Encoding-structure instrument only.
    memory_exponent: Negligible — store per-V r_Tr and N_nl.
    best_known: >-
      EV-BINSTD-56dda7 (ℓ=4 constant-rank collapse); IDEA-20261001-878222
      (parent band).
    hidden_overhead: Rank-diversity-seeking catalog construction + encoder constants.
    tradeoff_note: Larger catalogs buy floor power; do not invent band support.

  estimated_cost:
    implementation: low
    compute: low
    qualification: >-
      Estimate. Pure Python reuse of twin Trace meters; ≤4 CPU-hours at n=17
      with up to 128 encodings per Stage-1 cell.

  asymptotic_claim: null

  dominated_by: >-
    CHECKED IDEA-20261001-878222 / KR-IC-f5c584 dominate as the heuristic;
    this record only repairs catalog power after EV-BINSTD-56dda7.

  sota_delta:
    time: n/a — no attack
    memory: n/a
    data_queries: >-
      First rank-diversity-seeking catalog successor with floors as admission
      gates after EV-BINSTD-56dda7, same ≤−0.70 Trace→N_nl band.

  frontier_check:
    status: checked
    match_queries:
      - EV-BINSTD-56dda7 rank diverse ell=4 Trace N_nl
    top_hits:
      - EV-BINSTD-56dda7
      - IDEA-20261001-878222
      - KR-IC-f5c584
    note: Instrument-power repair; not a new Trace heuristic.

  interpretation_limits:
    - Encoding-structure correlation only; does not predict yield or beat rho.
    - Parent v1 O-INCONCLUSIVE remains; this does not rewrite EV-BINSTD-56dda7.
    - Stage-2 null not authorized.
    - If floors still fail at max catalog, successor is ℓ-scoped HEUR — not support.

  recommended_priority: high

  amazon_bedrock: NOT SELECTED, NOT CONFIGURED, NOT PROBED, NOT CONTACTED, NOT USED.
